H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H4994: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H4800: enlargement, either literally (an open space, usually in a good sense), or figuratively (liberty)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H5826: to surround, i.e. protect or aid
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H2620: to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
H5081: properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H5437: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H4135: to cut short, i.e. curtail (specifically the prepuce, i.e. to circumcise); by implication, to blunt; figuratively, to destroy
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H1846: to be extinguished; figuratively, to expire or be dried up
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H3444: something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity
H7440: properly, a creaking (or shrill sound), i.e. shout (of joy or grief)
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
H2428: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
H4191: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
H2421: to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
H5608: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H3256: to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct
H4194: death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H6605: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
H8179: an opening, i.e. door or gate
H6664: the right (natural, moral or legal); also (abstractly) equity or (figuratively) prosperity
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H6438: an angle; by implication, a pinnacle; figuratively, a chieftain
H854: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H6381: properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H1523: properly, to spin round (under the influence of any violent emotion), i.e. usually rejoice, or (as cringing) fear
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H3467: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
H6743: to push forward, in various senses (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive)
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H215: to be (causative, make) luminous (literally and metaphorically)
H631: to yoke or hitch; by analogy, to fasten in any sense, to join battle
H2282: a festival, or a victim therefor
H5688: something intwined, i.e. a string, wreath or foliage
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H7161: a horn (as projecting); by implication, a flask, cornet; by resemblance. an elephant's tooth (i.e. ivory), a corner (of the altar), a peak (of a mountain), a ray (of light); figuratively, power
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
